description: Logout endpoints revoke the intended set of persisted session tokens.

cases.description: A single-session logout revokes only the presented session token and leaves other sessions for the same account intact.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/logout/
logout.status=204
logout.url=/api/logout/
logout.body=null
before.total_tokens=2
after.total_tokens=1

cases.description: An all-sessions logout revokes every session token belonging to the authenticated account.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/logoutall/
logout.status=204
logout.url=/api/logoutall/
logout.body=null
before.total_tokens=10
after.total_tokens=0

cases.description: An all-sessions logout for one account does not revoke session tokens that belong to another account.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/logoutall/
logout.status=204
logout.url=/api/logoutall/
logout.body=null
before.user_tokens=10
before.other_user_tokens=10
after.user_tokens=0
after.other_user_tokens=10
after.total_tokens=10
